email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoInsulex patient with severe abdominal pain and vomiting
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 20-year-old male patient with a history of type 1 diabetes received their second dose of DemoInsulex (dose: 10 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-05-24.
Approximately 5 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe abdominal pain and vomiting.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
P. Tanaka (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter750@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
